decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the first floor eastern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used as a temporary sales/marketing suite comprising of a show flat (non-functional mock up) at first floor with office and sales area at ground level in association with Phase 1 of the redevelopment of Key Site 1 as approved by planning permission 00616/F/P5 and for no other purpose.

Condition : 6 - The use of the building hereby permitted shall cease by the 31st January 2008 on which date the building shall be vacated. The building shall be dismantled and the land made good and landscaped within one month of the use ceasing, in accordance with a scheme of work which shall first be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be laid out as approved.

Condition : 7 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to and within the the building shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include details of the proposed ramp to the building, including the gradient and height of the handrail system, and the access to the first floor disabled WC shall have a clear opening width of 1000mm and an outward opening door.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 8 - The proposed temporary sales/marketing suite due to its temporary nature, compatible scale, appearance and use, would be compatible with the character of the street scene, and would not harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers or result in insufficient town centre parking or conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore accords with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
description: Erection of a two storey temporary sales/marketing suite comprising a show flat (non functional mock up)at first floor with office and sales area at ground level.
